card.line: Mount Hermon is a tall, snow-capped mountain at Israel's northern edge, a landmark that marked the edge of the land God gave His people.

moments.title: Joshua wins the north
moments.text: Joshua took the whole land and struck down all its kings. His win reached Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon, at the foot of Mount Hermon.

moments.title: Hermon in Manasseh's land
moments.text: The half-tribe of Manasseh grew large and settled from Bashan to Baal-hermon, which is also called Senir and Mount Hermon.
